subject: Short-term retention exception + audit granularity — ClearHealth integration
messages:
From: Compliance Team <compliance@clearhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: retention exception + audit granularity for ClearHealth integration

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this. We're preparing for a regulated data intake and need a short-term exception to how Redwood persists certain telemetry while our implementation team finalizes a longer-term retention/archiving plan. Specifically: 

- We need audit-level event granularity for SSO events (login, token refresh, SCIM provisioning) for a 90-day window, exported in a schema we can ingest.
- For BYOK/KMS activity, we need key-use logs (encrypt/decrypt operations tied to customer key identifiers) retained for 30 days with proof-of-access controls.

Attached is our security questionnaire and a short justification doc. Can you tell us what evidence Redwood can produce today (schema examples, sample export) and whether a 30/90 day exception is feasible while we lock in retention rules on our side?

We'd like to schedule a triage call this week. Availability: Mon/Wed morning PT.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Compliance Manager, ClearHealth
Attachments: clearhealth_questionnaire.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Compliance Team <compliance@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: retention exception + audit granularity for ClearHealth integration

Hi Maya — thanks for the detail and the questionnaire.

Short answers up front: we can provide an export of audit events at the granularity you describe and we can offer a time-boxed exception for BYOK key-use logs for 30 days under a controlled intake process. The 90-day SSO window is possible as an evidence export but will require an intake ticket and scoped ingestion controls from your side.

Can we triage on Monday at 11:00 AM PT? I'll bring Ben (ops lead) and Karthik (product/infra) to clarify what artifacts are practical immediately versus what needs product work.

Requested artifacts from your side before the call (to speed the triage):
- The minimum fields you need from SSO audit events (timestamp, event_type, user_id, session_id, assertion_id, ip_addr)
- The BYOK key identifiers you expect us to link to your account (key IDs)
- Business justification for 90-day SSO retention (short paragraph)

I'll attach a short Redwood triage checklist after this thread and will create a HubSpot note.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

> Maya Singh
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: retention exception + audit granularity for ClearHealth integration

Kim / Karthik — quick ops checklist I want ready for the call:

1) Sample export: provide CSV/JSON schema and a 24h sample (anonymized) for SSO events. (I've uploaded audit_schema_v2.csv for reference).
2) KMS/BYOK: confirm which key IDs map to ClearHealth and whether key rotation is expected during the exception window.
3) Access controls: define which ClearHealth contacts should receive the exports and whether they will pull via secure S3 link or Redwoods' portal export.
4) Legal/PO: confirm any requested contractual change (short-term addendum) — we may need Legal sign-off for retention beyond typical windows.

I'll own the export mechanics if product agrees to the scope.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachments: audit_schema_v2.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: retention exception + audit granularity for ClearHealth integration

Looping in product constraints — we have an infra rollout in early July that modifies log retention defaults and introduces a new KV-tiering behavior. That means:

- We can sign off on a time-limited (30 day) exception for BYOK key-use logs with an operational control (export+delete) handled by Ops.
- 90-day SSO retention as a persistent change requires a product story (ETA: Q3; depends on capacity) — however, we can create a one-off export covering the requested 90-day window as a deliverable for ClearHealth.

Action items for triage call:
- Decide: export-only (Redwood prepares export and deletes retained data) vs persistent retention (requires product & legal)
- If export-only, Ops to schedule automated export cadence and confirm secure delivery (S3 presigned or direct ingestion).
- Log the request in HubSpot (CH-89321) and raise an internal SOC ticket so we can provision a temporary exception.

If we proceed with export-only, mark this high priority and I will allocate an engineer to approve export script before the call ends.

—Karthik
Senior Product Manager, Infra
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Compliance Team <compliance@clearhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: retention exception + audit granularity for ClearHealth integration

Maya — thanks everyone. Confirming the triage call: Monday 2027-06-21 11:00 AM PT (Google Meet link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=kim-parks-20270619-call).

Next steps (owners & timeline):
- ClearHealth: send minimal field list for SSO events + key IDs (due: Mon 08:00 AM PT) — Maya Singh
- Ops (Ben): produce anonymized 24h sample and audit_schema_v2.csv (due: Mon 10:00 AM PT)
- Product (Karthik): confirm whether export-only approach is acceptable and flag any infra conflicts (due: Mon 10:30 AM PT)
- Kimberly: open HubSpot note CH-89321 and create SOC incident for temporary exception; attach evidence after export.

I've attached a short Redwood triage checklist (redwood_triage_notes.txt) and added the HubSpot link to the record. If export-only is accepted, we'll treat this as a controlled evidence export with automated deletion after the agreed window.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_triage_notes.txt
